check_description: review_id values appearing on 2+ rows in stg_order_reviews (one review attached to every item of a multi-item order)
threshold_note: expected to grow with multi-item orders; a step change suggests a source re-extract

check_description: delivered orders with no order_delivered_customer_date (excludes canceled/unavailable, which never deliver)
threshold_note: review if share of delivered orders moves by more than 1pp between source drops

check_description: fact_orders.item_count = 0: orders with no item rows in the source extract
threshold_note: review if share moves by more than 1pp between source drops

check_description: orders with no payment rows at all in stg_order_payments (orders whose payment rows sum to zero are a separate, smaller oddity)
threshold_note: any increase above the current 1 order is a source anomaly

check_description: dim_products rows with no product_category_name in the source extract
threshold_note: review if count grows materially; these products are invisible to category cuts

check_description: reviews with no comment message (58.7% at first build; the silent majority of reviewers)
threshold_note: informational: tracks review-engagement mix, not a defect to fix
